description: Each action's hits; an action has at most two.

columns.name: action
columns.description: The action the hit belongs to.

columns.name: display_name
columns.description: Informational plain-text label; not a key or gameplay value.

columns.name: slot
columns.description: Which of the action's two hits. An absent hit is an all-zero word, so only hits that do something have a row.

columns.name: effect
columns.description: What the hit does to each target it lands on, using the stat calculator's amount where it needs one. apply-X and cure-X add or remove status X; cure-paralysis-poison-and-numbness removes all three and dispel removes every stat, element, quicken, silence, regeneration and magic-ward status. damage takes the amount from HP and wears the equipment. drain-mp takes the amount from MP, at most what the target has; drain-weapon-pp empties the target's weapon PP and drain-shield-pp its shield PP (only when the answered hit did damage). recover-hp, recover-mp, recover-weapon-pp and recover-weapon-dp add the amount; reduce-risk lowers risk by it. recover-hp-on-X heals the amount only when the hit being answered matches X: a spell, a non-spell, that affinity or any damage. random-X-increase and -decrease change that stat by 1-4. instant-defeat clears the statuses the instant-defeat rule lists and takes all remaining HP. armor-wear-from-damage wears the hit limb's armor DP by twice the HP damage already queued. mark-success-0 to -2 mark the user's action as succeeded for the field abilities that check it. set-script-flag-32 and -64 set that script flag to 1 when executed. unused-0 to -3 are refused.

columns.name: prerequisite
columns.description: Which targets the hit applies to, checked per target before the roll; a target that fails is skipped, and on the first hit it also counts as a miss. never-0 disables the hit. never-1, never-2 and never-3 make it direct: it applies once to the first target with no check and no roll, so hit_function is unread. always-2 applies it to the user instead. always-0, always-1 and unused-0 to -2 accept every target, except that always-0 on the second hit skips a target whose first hit was cancelled. undead and not-undead accept only that enemy class. can-apply-X accepts a target that can receive status X: the rule exists, the target is not immune and no blocking status is active. Equipment up and down also need armor, a shield or a blade; the attack-ups a blade; the defense-ups armor or a shield. can-apply-instant-defeat-undead and -living also accept only undead or only living targets. Earlier names: can-apply-banish (now -analyze), can-apply-exorcise (-instant-defeat-undead) and can-apply-drain (-instant-defeat-living).

columns.name: hit_function
columns.description: How the percent chance to hit is worked out when the hit rolls. follows-previous-hit: 100 if the action's last roll landed (for one target, its first hit), else a miss. gem-modifier: 100, +20 with the matching accuracy gem on the user's drawn weapon, -20 for each matching protective gem on the target's drawn shield. agility-difference: 100 + the user's agility - the target's agility and limb defense, each scaled by (100 - its risk)%. intelligence-difference: the same with intelligence and no 100, the target's side also scaled by its HP fraction. agility-difference-2: 130 - the action's cost in place of 100. These three vary by up to 5 either way when executed and add the gem bonuses. risk: (user's risk + 150) x 100 / 256. chain-evasion: (255 - the target limb's chain_evasion) x 100 / 255. none: refused if rolled. A spell starts at 0 against a spell-immune target. The chance doubles against a left-arm-impaired target and is capped at 100; the player's rolls then get a hidden +10.

columns.name: stat_calculator
columns.description: How the amount the effect uses is worked out. physical-damage-with-status-modifiers and -without- use strength (with halves it while the user is right-arm-impaired), magic-damage intelligence and hp-healed intelligence for healing: the user's stat and gear rating scaled by stat_factor, less the target's stat, armor and shield defense, with random variation. item-recovery: 5 x stat_factor, varying by up to 5. recoverable-hp and -mp: the target's missing HP or MP. risk: the target's risk. weapon-pp and shield-pp: the user's weapon or shield PP (shield-pp was equipped-shield-dp). hp-lost-factor and mp-lost-factor: the user's missing HP or MP x stat_factor / 10. current-hp-factor: the target's HP x stat_factor / 100. previous-hit-factor-0 to -2: the HP and MP damage the chained attack dealt its first target x stat_factor / 10. magic-, physical- and damage-received factors: the answered hit's damage x stat_factor / 10 when it did damage and was a spell, not a spell, or either. spell-cost-factor: the answered spell's MP cost x stat_factor / 10. last-value: the previous calculation's amount; last-value-factor: it x stat_factor / 10. trap-panel-damage and heal-panel-hp-healed: the target's max HP / 10 x stat_factor + 10 per trap level, less its defense. weapon-pp and the hp-lost, mp-lost, current-hp and previous-hit calculators add 1 for each earlier ability in a chain. none: no amount, for status effects.

columns.name: stat_factor
columns.description: The stat calculator's multiplier: +10% attack per point for the damage and healing calculators, 5 HP or MP per point for item-recovery, tenths for the *-factor calculators (hundredths for current-hp-factor) and the max-HP multiplier for the trap panels. The other calculators ignore it.

columns.name: damage_type
columns.description: The hit's damage type; none lets a physical hit use the user's weapon's, or blunt without a blade.

columns.name: affinity
columns.description: The hit's element. weapon takes the user's drawn blade's highest affinity, or physical when the weapon is sheathed, absent or has none above zero. hp-healed refuses weapon, and physical while the user's weapon is drawn.
